summary: node1 now has a persistent firewalld policy permitting SSH and TCP 8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections. Cockpit exposure was removed. The configuration survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Kept SSH permitted and added TCP 8080 to the permanent public zone.
Removed the unrelated Cockpit service allowance.
Verified live kernel accept and reject rules.
Tested ingress through a non-loopback network namespace: TCP 22 and 8080 connected; listening TCP 9090 was rejected.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot ID changed.
Repeated service, policy, listener, and packet-behavior checks after restart.
Removed all temporary test interfaces, namespaces, listeners, and files.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080
evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent public-zone policies contain SSH and TCP 8080; recovered nftables rules accept ports 22 and 8080.
With real listeners on both 8080 and unrelated 9090, external-style tests connected to 22/8080 while 9090 received an administrative rejection, both before and after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 70ed4f72-e9f4-4bd6-8a6f-aed07d62a726; firewalld, SSH, persistent rules, listeners, and packet behavior recovered.
No temporary namespace listeners remain, and firewalld and sshd are active.
